title: 第14章  连废十一，一州留名！
content_zh:
“啧啧啧。”
李山崖闻言，顿时阴阳怪气的冷笑两声。
“你这是准备拿问道宗来威胁老夫？”
李山崖摸着下巴，略带讥讽的说道：“要不试试？”
“嘶！”
倒吸冷气的声音再次响起。
都说这李山崖是个滚刀肉，还真是传言非虚啊。
苏崇山的脸色愈发阴沉，他冷声道：“李老家主，你当真要为了一个外人，和我苏家作对？”
“想多了。”
李山崖翻了个白眼，说道：“我只是来替我孙女讨个说法，老夫可没那份闲心，为谁出头。”
“爷爷！”
听到这话，李天骄顿时急得直跳脚。
“原来如此，那是在下误会了。”
苏崇山闻言，心中顿时松了口气。
他朝着李山崖拱手一拜，说道：“之前是在下有所冒犯，我在此向您老道歉。”
“但是！”
苏崇山看向方玄，眼中杀意已经快要凝为实质。
“方玄杀了我儿，此仇不共戴天，谁敢阻止，我苏家定要与他不死不休！”
此话一出，数道身影顿时越众而出。
这些人，都是苏崇山带来的护卫，周身散发出凛冽的元气。

赫然都是炼体境的武者。
他们一出现，就将方玄围在中间，神情冰冷。
围观者见状，纷纷后退，拉开距离，生怕惨遭池鱼。
“方玄哥哥......”
见到方玄被如此多武者围住，李天骄正要上去帮忙，却被李山崖一把拉住。
“丫头，你做什么？”
李山崖沉声道：“这是方家和苏家之间的恩怨，你瞎掺和什么劲?”
“可是......”
李天骄话没说完，就被李山崖直接打断。
“没什么可是。”
李山崖说道：“任何人都要为自己的所作所为承担相应的代价，若是那方家小子今日丢掉性命，那也是他命中注定，怨不得旁人。”
“但这件事他又没错。”
李天骄替方玄感到愤愤不平。
“是非对错有时候并不重要。”
李山崖少有的对孙女严肃起来。
“重要的是家族传承。”
闻言，李天骄沉默了。
她并非听不懂爷爷的话。
这是告诉她，要时刻
但是......

当她视线落在那个白衣少年身上的时候，眼底满是不甘、无力。
“丫头，你给爷爷
李山崖放缓语气，轻声说道：“无论那方家小子，能够逃过这一劫。以后都尽量离他远些。”
李天骄咬着嘴唇，没有说话。
见状，李山崖内心无奈的叹了口气。
眼见李山崖选择了袖手旁观，苏崇山心神也是为之一松。
因为某些事情，苏家和方家已经彻底交恶。
若是李家再插足进来，事态必然会进一步扩大，难以收场。
好在，李山崖看似蛮横，但并不愚蠢。
他看向方玄，一抹狰狞杀意，攀爬上他的脸庞。
“给我把他拿下！”
苏崇山一挥手，冷声说道：“杀我儿子，我要亲手将他浑身骨头，一根根的拆下来！”
“你们敢！”
这时，方雨容大步上前，将方玄挡在身后，怒视苏崇山。
“你们苏家，还真是连脸皮都不要了。”
面对苏家这么多强者，方雨容多少还是有些紧张。
“这场赌约，在场所有人都可以作证，是苏晨挑衅在先，又是他技不如人，有此下场也是咎由自取。”
方雨容语调拔高，试图得到众人的支持，大声道：“难道，苏家人都这般输不起吗？”
围观者无人回应。
他们看看热闹也就算了。

真涉及到两大家族之间的争斗，他们可没那个胆子敢参与进去。
无论说什么做什么，都会得罪一方。
还不如当个哑巴，好好看戏就行了。
明哲保身才是王道。
看到这一幕，方雨容心中一沉，俏脸微白。
她的计划，落空了。
苏崇山嗤笑一声：“说一千道一万，方玄杀了我儿，他就该死！”
“动手！”
“是！”
随着苏崇山一声令下，数名炼体境护卫周身元气暴涨，带起凌厉的劲风，朝着方玄扑了过去。
他们都是苏家精心培养的护卫，常年厮杀，实战经验极为丰富，就如方家的家族护卫一般。
这些护卫一经出手，攻势凶猛，封死了方玄所有的退路，根本不给方玄逃走的机会。
方雨容脸色惨白，周身元气微微流转，冲向一名苏家护卫。
掌风如电，元气绽放间，竟然将那人震退出去。
“方玄，你快走，我替你拦着！”
击退一人，方雨容提醒方玄先走。
“不知死活的臭丫头！”
苏崇山眼中寒芒闪烁，冷喝道：“连她也一并拿下！”
当即，实力最强的一名护卫，如同猎鹰般扑向方雨容。
仅仅只是数招，就将方雨容彻底压制住。

眼看方玄已经被数名苏家护卫围住，方雨容又气又急，却无法摆脱对手。
就在护卫们的拳脚即将落在方玄身上的瞬间，方玄终于动了。
他身形微微一侧，如同闲庭信步一般，轻松避开了最前方那名护卫落下的拳头。
那护卫一拳落空，重心不稳，踉跄着向前扑去。
方玄反手一掌，轻轻拍在他的后心。
“嘭！”
一声闷响，那名刚入炼体境的护卫，如同被重锤击中一般，身体猛地向前飞出去，重重摔在地上。
哇的喷出一口鲜血，挣扎了几下，便再也爬不起来。
其周身元气紊乱，显然是被废了修为。
“怎么可能？！”
全场哗然！
所有人都瞪大了眼睛，满脸难以置信。
随手一击，就废掉一名炼体境武者？
这也太匪夷所思了。
让他们更加震惊的一幕出现了。
方玄身形辗转腾挪，游走在一众苏家护卫之中。
或拍出一掌。
或轰出一拳。
无一例外，这些苏家护卫，无人能够承受他的一击。
不过十几个呼吸的时间，所有苏家护卫，全部倒在地上。

要么骨骼断裂，要么丹田破碎。
全部被废！
“嘶！”
一片片倒吸凉气的声音，响彻全场。
他们看向方玄的目光，充满了敬畏和恐惧。
造血境碾压炼体境，还一次性击败数名炼体境护卫。
这等天赋和实力，简直是闻所未闻，见所未见！
苏崇山的笑容瞬间凝固在脸上，眼中满是震惊和难以置信。
他带来的可是足足十二名护卫啊。
而且都是炼体境的修为。
眨眼间，就被方玄废了十一个！
剩下那一个，还是因为出手对付方雨容，所以侥幸逃过一劫。
“不可能！你一个造血境的小畜生，怎么可能有这么强的力量？！”
李山崖的眼中，也闪过一丝震惊之色。
“好灵活的身法，好霸道的拳风，好果决的手段！”
以造血境修为，独战十一名炼体境武者。
而且还是以碾压的方式赢了，即便李山崖见多识广，也不由得为方玄喝一声彩。
反观方玄，白衣胜雪，脸上古井无波。
他身怀混沌圣体，拥有九帝传承。
于武楼中，打破极限，突破自我。

领悟武道极境。
这个境界，让方玄在同境之中，早就立于不败之地。
至于苏家这些炼体境护卫。
说实话，还不如他在武楼挑战中遇到的那些毒刺甲牛。
废之何难。
“方玄哥哥真是太厉害了。”
李天骄双手捧心，眼中满是小星星。
刚好看到这一幕的人，想死的心都有了。
连李天骄这样的天之骄女，都被方玄征服了吗？
“方玄！”
苏崇山双眼血红，声嘶力竭的咆哮道：“你杀我儿，又伤我苏家如此多护卫，我定要与你不死不休！”
“我和你苏家，本就不死不休。”
方玄目含杀意，语气淡漠。
“苏清瑶对我做的一切，我会一笔一笔收回来！”
“他们不是第一个，更不会是最后一个！”
闻言，苏崇山怒极而笑。
“好，好，好！”
苏崇山五官扭曲，面色狰狞。
“我终究小瞧你了，但是今日，你插翅难逃！”
说罢，苏崇山周身元气沸腾，直接朝方玄轰出一拳。

“给我死！”
面对苏崇山的攻击，方玄面色凝重，寒芒闪烁。
毕竟是聚气境的强者。
远超他两个大境界。
纵然身怀圣体，领悟极境。
但两个境界的差距，宛如鸿沟，无法弥补。
即便如此，方玄脸上也不见半丝畏惧。
他手指叩印，体内气血奔涌如火，九转金丹运转不休。
眼底杀意流转，周身战意沸腾。
就在方玄正要施展杀道王拳，与那苏崇山硬碰硬的时候，一道令人压抑的气息，蓦地从天而降。
这股气息，如海如潮，镇压八方。
无数人，在这股威压之下，只觉得双腿颤颤，无法维持身形。
李山崖豁然抬头，看向上方，瞳孔不由得一缩。
只见九层高的武楼之上，一道身影不知何时出现在那里。
一身气息，深不可测。
武楼的镇守者么。
李山崖面露凝重。
“武楼重地，禁止武斗！”
那人缓缓开口，声如清风。
正在出手的苏崇山，只觉得一股无形力量落在身上，将他带出数米之外。

“阁下，在下苏家苏崇山，今日只为儿子报仇，何错之有？”
即便再忌惮对方，但苏崇山还是硬着头皮说道：“难道武楼是要偏袒杀人凶手不成？”
“我武楼不过问世事，不插足世家之争，何来偏袒一说？”
面对苏崇山的质问，那人并不恼怒，语气平静如海。
“那您为何......”
不等苏崇山说完，只见那人手掌一挥，武楼前的石碑上，一道金光绽放，直冲九霄。
武楼镇守者的话，再次传进众人耳中。
“方玄，连闯九楼，一州留名！”
content_en:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk."
When Li Shanya heard this, he suddenly sneered in a strange way.
"Are you planning to threaten me with Taoism?"
Li Shanya touched his chin and said sarcastically: "How about giving it a try?"
"Hiss!"
The sound of gasping air sounded again.
People say that Li Shanya is a piece of meat, but the rumors are true.
Su Chongshan's face became more and more gloomy, and he said coldly: "Master Li, do you really want to go against my Su family for the sake of an outsider?"
"Thinking too much."
Li Shanya rolled his eyes and said, "I'm just here to ask for an explanation for my granddaughter. I don't have the time to stand up for anyone."
"Grandpa!"
Hearing this, Li Tianjiao suddenly jumped up and down anxiously.
"I see, it was a misunderstanding."
When Su Chongshan heard this, he felt relieved.
He bowed his hands towards Li Shanya and said, "I have offended you before, and I would like to apologize to you."
"But!"
Su Chongshan looked at Fang Xuan, the murderous intent in his eyes was about to solidify.
"Fang Xuan killed my son. This hatred is irreconcilable. If anyone dares to stop him, our Su family will fight him to the death!"
As soon as these words came out, several figures suddenly emerged from the crowd.
These people were all guards brought by Su Chongshan, and they exuded cold vitality.
Astonishingly, they are all warriors in the body refining realm.
As soon as they appeared, they surrounded Fang Xuan with cold expressions.
When the onlookers saw this, they backed away and distanced themselves, for fear of being killed.
"Brother Fang Xuan..."
Seeing Fang Xuan surrounded by so many warriors, Li Tianjiao was about to go up to help, but was grabbed by Li Shanya.
"Girl, what are you doing?"
Li Shanya said in a deep voice: "This is a grudge between the Fang family and the Su family. Why are you meddling in it?"
"But..."
Before Li Tianjiao finished speaking, he was directly interrupted by Li Shanya.
"Nothing but."
Li Shanya said: "Everyone must bear the corresponding price for what he has done. If that boy from the Fang family loses his life today, it is his destiny and he cannot blame others."
"But he's not wrong about this."
Li Tianjiao felt aggrieved for Fang Xuan.
“Right and wrong sometimes don’t matter.”
Li Shanya became unusually serious towards his granddaughter.
“What’s important is the family legacy.”
Hearing this, Li Tianjiao fell silent.
It's not that she doesn't understand her grandfather's words.
This tells her to always
But...
When her eyes fell on the young man in white, her eyes were full of unwillingness and helplessness.
"Girl, give it to grandpa
Li Shanya slowed down his tone and said softly: "No matter which boy from the Fang family can escape this disaster. Try to stay away from him in the future. "
Li Tianjiao bit his lip and said nothing.
Seeing this, Li Shanya sighed helplessly.
Seeing that Li Shanya chose to stand by and watch, Su Chongshan felt relieved.
Because of certain things, the Su family and the Fang family have completely turned against each other.
If the Li family gets involved again, the situation will inevitably escalate and become difficult to end.
Fortunately, Li Shanya may seem arrogant, but he is not stupid.
He looked at Fang Xuan, and a ferocious killing intent appeared on his face.
"Get him! "
Su Chongshan waved his hand and said coldly: "Kill my son, and I will personally remove all his bones one by one! "
"How dare you! "
At this time, Fang Yurong strode forward, blocked Fang Xuan behind him, and glared at Su Chongshan.
“You, the Su family, really don’t even have any shame. "
Facing so many powerful people from the Su family, Fang Yurong was still a little nervous.
"In this bet, everyone present can testify that it was Su Chen who made the provocation first, and he was not as skilled as others. He is the one to blame for this outcome. "
Fang Yurong spoke in a high-pitched tone, trying to gain support from everyone, and said loudly: "Is it true that the Su family cannot afford to lose? "
None of the onlookers responded.
They just want to see the excitementnever mind.
If it really involves a fight between two major families, they don't have the guts to get involved.
No matter what you say or do, you will offend someone.
It's better to be a mute and just watch the show.
The right way to protect yourself is to be wise and wise.
Seeing this scene, Fang Yurong's heart sank and her pretty face turned pale.
Her plan failed.
Su Chongshan sneered: "If Fang Xuan kills my son, he deserves to die!"
"Do it!"
"Yes!"
Following Su Chongshan's order, the vitality of several Body Refining Realm guards surged, bringing up fierce winds, and rushed towards Fang Xuan.
They are all carefully trained guards of the Su family. They have been fighting each other all year round and have extremely rich practical experience, just like the family guards of the Fang family.
Once these guards took action, they attacked fiercely, blocking all Fang Xuan's escape routes and not giving Fang Xuan a chance to escape.
Fang Yurong's face turned pale, and his energy flowed slightly, and he rushed towards a Su family guard.
The wind in his palm was like lightning, and as his vitality blossomed, he actually knocked the man away.
"Fang Xuan, leave quickly, I'll stop you!"
After repelling one person, Fang Yurong reminded Fang Xuan to go first.
"You stinky girl who doesn't know how to live or die!"
Su Chongshan's eyes flashed coldly, and he shouted coldly: "Take her down too!"
Immediately, one of the strongest guards pounced on Fang Yurong like a falcon.
With just a few moves, Fang Yurong was completely suppressed.
Seeing that Fang Xuan was surrounded by several Su family guards, Fang Yurong was angry and anxious, but could not get rid of his opponent.
Just when the guards' fists and kicks were about to fall on Fang Xuan, Fang Xuan finally moved.
He turned his body slightly to one side, as if strolling in a courtyard, and easily avoided the fist of the guard at the front.
The guard's punch missed, his center of gravity was unstable, and he staggered forward.
Fang Xuan used his backhand and patted him lightly on the back of his heart.
"Bang!"
With a muffled sound, the body of the guard who had just entered the Body Refining Realm flew forward suddenly as if he had been hit by a heavy hammer, and fell heavily to the ground.
He spurted out a mouthful of blood, struggled a few times, and then couldn't get up again.
The vitality of his whole body was in disorder, and his cultivation had obviously been abolished.
"How is that possible?!"
The whole place was in an uproar!
Everyone's eyes widened with disbelief on their faces.
To destroy a body refining realm warrior with one casual blow?
This is too incredible.
A scene that shocked them even more appeared.
Fang Xuan's body moved around, walking among the Su family guards.
Or give a slap.
Or throw a punch.
Without exception, none of these Su family guards could withstand his blow.
In just a dozen breaths, all the Su family guards fell to the ground.
Either the bones are broken or the Dantian is broken.
All were scrapped!
"Hiss!"
Sounds of gasping for air resounded throughout the audience.
They looked at Fang Xuan with eyes filled with awe and fear.
The blood-making realm crushed the body-refining realm and defeated several body-refining realm guards at once.
This level of talent and strength is simply unheard of and unseen!
Su Chongshan's smile instantly froze on his face, his eyes full of shock and disbelief.
He brought a total of twelve guards.
And they are all at the Body Refining Realm.
In the blink of an eye, eleven of them were defeated by Fang Xuan!
The remaining one had a chance to escape because he took action against Fang Yurong.
"Impossible! How can you, a little beast in the blood-making realm, be so powerful?!"
Li Shanya's eyes also flashed with a hint of shock.
"What a flexible body, what a domineering boxing style, what a decisive approach!"
With the blood-making realm cultivation level, he fought alone against eleven body-refining realm warriors.
And he still won by crushing him. Even though Li Shanya was well-informed, he couldn't help but cheer for Fang Xuan.
Looking back at Fang Xuan, his white clothes are better than snow, and his face is as smooth as ever.
He possesses the Holy Body of Chaos and possesses the inheritance of the Nine Emperors.
In the martial arts building, break the limit and break throughself.
Understand the ultimate realm of martial arts.
This realm made Fang Xuan invincible long ago in the same realm.
As for the Body Refining Realm guards of the Su family.
To be honest, it was not as good as the poisonous stinging armored cows he encountered in the Wu Lou challenge.
How difficult is it to abolish it.
"Brother Fang Xuan is really awesome."
Li Tianjiao held his heart in his hands, his eyes filled with little stars.
Anyone who happened to see this scene wanted to die.
Has even a proud woman like Li Tianjiao been conquered by Fang Xuan?
"Fang Xuan!"
Su Chongshan's eyes were bloodshot and he roared at the top of his lungs: "You killed my son and injured so many of my Su family's guards. I will fight you to the death!"
"Your Su family and I are fighting to the death."
Fang Xuan's eyes contained murderous intent and his tone was indifferent.
"I will take back everything Su Qingyao did to me!"
"They are not the first, and they will not be the last!"
Hearing this, Su Chongshan laughed angrily.
"Okay, okay, okay!"
Su Chongshan's facial features were distorted and his expression was ferocious.
"I underestimated you after all, but today, you can't escape!"
After saying that, Su Chongshan's energy boiled all over his body and he punched Fang Xuan directly.
"Die!"
Facing Su Chongshan's attack, Fang Xuan's face was solemn, with a cold light flickering.
After all, he is a strong person in the Qi Gathering Realm.
Far beyond his two realms.
Even if you are carrying the holy body, you will realize the ultimate state.
But the gap between the two realms is like a chasm that cannot be bridged.
Even so, there was no trace of fear on Fang Xuan's face.
He tapped his fingers, and the energy and blood in his body surged like fire, and the Nine-turn Golden Pill circulated endlessly.
Killing intent flowed in his eyes, and fighting spirit boiled around his body.
Just when Fang Xuan was about to use the Killing Dao King Fist and face off against Su Chongshan, a depressing aura suddenly fell from the sky.
This aura is like a sea and a tide, suppressing all directions.
Countless people, under this pressure, only felt that their legs were shaking and they were unable to maintain their body shape.
Li Shanya suddenly raised his head and looked upward, his pupils shrinking involuntarily.
I saw a figure appearing there on the nine-story martial building.
An aura that is unfathomable.
The guardian of Wu Tower?
Li Shanya looked solemn.
"In this important place of martial arts, martial arts are prohibited!"
The man spoke slowly, his voice like the breeze.
Su Chongshan, who was taking action, felt an invisible force fall on him, taking him a few meters away.
"Your Excellency, Su Chongshan of the Su family is only seeking revenge for his son today. What is wrong with him?"
Even though he was still wary of the other party, Su Chongshan still said bravely: "Is Wu Lou trying to favor the murderer?"
"I, Wu Lou, only care about worldly affairs and do not interfere in the disputes between aristocratic families. How can I show favoritism?"
Facing Su Chongshan's questioning, the man was not angry, and his tone was as calm as the sea.
"Then why did you..."
Before Su Chongshan could finish speaking, the man waved his hand, and a golden light bloomed on the stone tablet in front of the Wu Tower, shooting straight into the sky.
The words of the guardian of Wu Tower reached everyone's ears again.
"Fang Xuan, he broke through the ninth floor in a row and left his name in a state!"
